title: Train Cab (Wolf Rail)
layout_order: badge (left, top) | SHUNT row CHANGE ENDS, COUPLE, UNCOUPLE, TURNTABLE (top band) | ? then X (top right) | controls panel: Easy (lever STOP/SLOW/GO, FORWARD/BACK) or driver's (power, brake, reverser) | AUTO over POINTS | speed dial (centre) | SIGNAL | THE LINE AHEAD (lead lamp, station, track strip, LINE BRAKING, horn, mode) | note box, refusal strip, guide card stacked above

controls.label: DRIVING - SHOW THE CAB
controls.when: driving, cab hidden by the driver
controls.tip: You are still driving: show the Train Cab (F4)
source: "You are still driving: show the Train Cab (F4)"

controls.label: <walk note> / You have two minutes to sit down there. Click to close this message.
controls.when: after CHANGE ENDS until the other cab opens
controls.tip: <walk note> - click to close this message
source: "You have two minutes to sit down there. Click to close this message."

controls.label: X
controls.tip: Hide the Train Cab - F4 (you keep driving; F4 or Wolf World > Vehicles & Travel > Train Cab brings it back)
source: "Hide the Train Cab - F4 (you keep driving; F4 or Wolf World > Vehicles & Travel > Train Cab brings it back)"
case H_CLOSE: mShowHelp = false; tr.toggleShown(); break;

controls.tip: How to drive

controls.name: badge
controls.label: WOLF GRID RAILROAD / train name or 'Your train' or 'Train Cab' / kind - vehicles - region

controls.name: not-driving
controls.label: Sit in the cab of a Wolf Rail engine to drive it.
source: "Sit in the cab of a Wolf Rail engine to drive it."

controls.label: STOP
controls.tip: Stop: brake to a stand

controls.label: SLOW
controls.tip: Slow: a third of the line's speed / Slow: back very slowly
source: "Slow: a third of the line's speed"

controls.label: GO
controls.tip: Go: the line's speed / Go: back slowly

controls.name: easy-lever
controls.label: the lever knob in its gate at the chosen notch; EASY DRIVING; Up / Down: the lever; F5: forward or back
FORWARD
controls.tip: Forward (F5: forward or back)

controls.label: BACK / BACKING
controls.tip: Back, slowly - to back out of a platform. Stop the train first (F5: forward or back)
source: "Back, slowly - to back out of a platform. Stop the train first (F5: forward or back)"

controls.label: REGULATOR / POWER / CONTROLLER (by kind) and its %
controls.tip: Drag up to pull harder (Up / Down keys too)
source: "Drag up to pull harder (Up / Down keys too)"

controls.label: BRAKE and its %
controls.tip: Drag up to brake harder (Up / Down keys too)
source: "Drag up to brake harder (Up / Down keys too)"

controls.label: FORWARD
controls.tip: Forward (F5: forward, neutral, reverse in turn)

controls.label: NEUTRAL
controls.tip: Neutral: no power reaches the wheels (F5)

controls.label: REVERSE
controls.tip: Reverse: with the train standing, power backs it along its line (F5)
source: "Reverse: with the train standing, power backs it along its line (F5)"

controls.name: auto-overlay
controls.label: AUTO / Auto - the train is driving itself / Take a lever, or press AUTO, to drive yourself.
source: "Take a lever, or press AUTO, to drive yourself."

controls.label: AUTO with ON / OFF / ONE MOMENT
controls.tip: Drive yourself again (F8) / Auto: the train drives itself - the line's speed, stations and signals (F8) / ... Let both levers go first (F8)
source: "Auto: the train drives itself - the line's speed, stations and signals"

controls.label: POINTS: name, Set left/right/auto, in <distance>, Press to change / Too far to change / Set by the line; None in sight
controls.tip: Change the points ahead - one press (F9) / No points ahead on the line / These points can be changed from <d> away / These points are set by the line's owner, not from the cab
source: "These points are set by the line's owner, not from the cab"

controls.label: speed dial: ticks every 10, figures every 20, red arc past the line speed, needle, speed figure, mph / km/h
controls.tip: Click for km/h (F3) / Click for mph (F3)

controls.name: status-word
controls.label: AUTO / BACKING / EASY DRIVING / YOU ARE DRIVING (over the dial)
CHANGE ENDS / F6
controls.tip: Change ends: then walk to the cab at the other end and sit in it (F6)
source: "Change ends: then walk to the cab at the other end and sit in it (F6)"

controls.label: COUPLE / Stock <d> ahead|behind / Set FORWARD|REVERSE|BACK first
controls.tip: Couple to <name>, <d> ahead|behind. Set <way> towards it, then press COUPLE (F7); press again to stop
source: " towards it, then press COUPLE (F7); press again to stop"

controls.label: UNCOUPLE / Shift+F7
controls.tip: Uncouple: your cab's part leaves the rest standing on its own (Shift+F7)
source: "Uncouple: your cab's part leaves the rest standing on its own (Shift+F7)"

controls.label: TURNTABLE / <turntable name>
controls.tip: Turn your engine round on the turntable <name>: you stay in the cab and go round with it. One press (button only - no key)
source: ": you stay in the cab and go round with it. One press (button only - no key)"

controls.name: signal
controls.label: SIGNAL lamp; STOP / CAUTION / CLEAR; in <d>; The train waits / Next one red / Line clear; None in sight
lead lamp YOUR CAB LEADS / PROPELLING (tooltip); note box (tooltip); refusal text (tooltip)
controls.when: lead= known; a note; a refusal
controls.tip: You are in the cab at the front of the train / Propelling: your cab is not at the front, so the train is pushed from behind you / <note> / <refusal>
source: "You are in the cab at the front of the train"
"Propelling: your cab is not at the front, so the train is pushed from behind you"
addHit(l, b, r, t, H_NONE, c.mNote);
addHit(l, b, r - S(112.f), t, H_NONE, tr.alert());

controls.name: line-ahead
controls.label: THE LINE AHEAD / THE LINE BEHIND; No station in sight / Backing / End of the run in <d> / Station in <d>; Track in front of you / behind you: <d>; track strip (engine, stop, line end)
source: "Track behind you: " : "Track in front of you: "

controls.name: line-braking
controls.label: LINE BRAKING lamp (lit red while the line brakes the train)
WHISTLE / HORN / GONG (held)
controls.tip: Sound the whistle|gong|horn (hold)
controls.action: WolfTrain::setHorn(true) on press, setHorn(false) on release or capture lost

controls.label: SWITCH TO DRIVER'S MODE / SWITCH TO EASY DRIVING
controls.tip: Switch to the driver's own levers - F2 (the train stops first) / Switch to the one-lever Easy driving - F2 (the train stops first)
source: "SWITCH TO DRIVER'S MODE" : "SWITCH TO EASY DRIVING"
"Switch to the driver's own levers - F2 (the train stops first)"
"Switch to the one-lever Easy driving - F2 (the train stops first)"

controls.label: OK on the red refusal strip
controls.tip: Close this message (Escape)

controls.label: < Back
controls.when: guide open, not on the first card
source: case H_HELP_BACK: mHelpPage = llmax(0, mHelpPage - 1); break;

controls.label: Next >
controls.when: guide open, not on the last card
source: case H_HELP_NEXT: mHelpPage = llmin(CARD_COUNT - 1, mHelpPage + 1); break;

controls.label: Got it

controls.name: guide-cards
controls.label: 10 cards with dots: Welcome to the cab, Easy driving, Driver's mode, The horn and the dial, Auto, Signals and points, Changing ends, End of the line and turntables, Driving from the keyboard, Your gestures
controls.when: guide open; opens by itself the first time (WolfTrainCabHelpSeen)

controls.name: resize-grip
controls.label: top edge: drag to size (WolfTrainCabScale), double-click for the default, tooltip WolfHudResize::tip()

controls.name: keys
controls.label: Up/W, Down/S (lever), F2 mode, F3 units, F4 hide/show, F5 direction, F6 change ends, F7 couple, Shift+F7 uncouple, F8 auto, F9 points, Escape refusal OK

controls.name: menu
controls.label: Wolf World > Vehicles & Travel > Train Cab (Wolf Rail); commit WolfTrain.Toggle (LEAP UI call)

controls.name: click-through
controls.label: clicks and right-clicks on the panel, the guide, the refusal strip never reach the world
